title: First engineering slice: real tools, real receipts
hypothesis: A local 4B model can complete a read-edit-test-commit cycle through a scoped executor, and hosted agents can be confined to the same executor.

rows: fixed, tests pass, committed; 3 of 10 calls spent finding the test command
Claude Code / Opus (plan, Haven tools only)
Opus supervising a Qwen child (leased slugify.py)
both fixed; supervisor reviewed child diff before commit
incomplete: 2 of 3 failures fixed at 20-min limit

finding: Every outcome above was re-checked outside the agent (tests re-run, commits inspected, ledgers verified). An owner approval from the browser is recorded in the signed receipt as decided_by owner.
limits: Single runs. The solo-Qwen run spent ~700 s waiting for approvals triggered by a classifier bug (quoted ';' and newlines), since fixed.
